# ghost/feeder

Read public RSS news in Feeder without an account. Add a public HTTPS feed, list visible previews and read stored RSS article text through an explicit native-reader route; no external browser or posting.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/feeder
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/feeder open --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/feeder add_feed --device <serial> --param feed_url=<feed_url>
ghost skill run ghost/feeder list_articles --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/feeder open_article --device <serial> --param index=<index>
ghost skill run ghost/feeder read_article --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/feeder back_to_list --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open`: Open Feeder public RSS article listing
- `add_feed`: Discover and add a public HTTPS RSS feed to the local app
- `list_articles`: List complete visible article previews from the current feed
- `open_article`: Open a visible article using the explicit internal reader menu
- `read_article`: Read stored RSS article text in the native internal reader
- `back_to_list`: Return from the native article reader to the feed listing
